'''Niim Stroolg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Caarite]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He worked for the [[Metatheran Cartel]] and eventually became an executive in charge of "resource investigation", serving as an overseer to some of the Cartel's [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. During the [[Confederation Rock Rush]] in c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Stroolg and five other [[Caarite]]s traveled into the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[MCT Nuurglat|MCT ''Nuurglat'']], and landed in a cavern inside an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. However, they inadvertently reawoke a [[shadow creature]] that was slumbering inside the rock, and it drove Stroolg and the other Caarites to inflict [[Death/Legends|fatal]] wounds on themselves. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] later traveled to the asteroid, and they discovered the bodies of Stroolg and his crew.
